geometry.visible_cell_rule: Divide each output usable rectangle into columns and enough rows for that output visible-item count; inset by grid_gap. Existing layout/Fit/Fill control variants are separate factors. Record actual bar usable insets in the run manifest.
geometry.off_camera_rule: Use each item off_camera_origin; preserve its workspace and required hidden semantics.
geometry.quality: normal supported content, alpha, effects, text precision; no silent simplification
geometry.visibility_oracle: Visibility labels are intended fixture demand: adapters must verify actual geometry and exposed complete pixels; labels alone do not establish visible content or acceptance.

generation.record_uid: SHA-256 of UTF-8(seed + slash + key), first 16 bytes encoded as 26 Crockford-base32 digits, prefix r_
generation.item_order: normal_families order; multiplier consecutive items per family, zero-based ordinal n
generation.visibility: n mod 4 below 2 visible; equal 2 off-camera; equal 3 inactive
generation.grid_slot: number of earlier visible items in same workspace
generation.shared_record_key: scene/local/record/(family ordinal mod 4) for record-view, rich-description and query-list
